rationale: Jess is a founder building in stealth with a strong full-stack tech foundation (JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Ruby), while Arfan brings deep hardware-software integration expertise from Apple—including embedded systems, IoT, and medical device prototyping. Their skill sets are highly complementary: if Jess's product involves any hardware component, IoT integration, or embedded systems, Arfan's R&D and prototyping background could be invaluable; conversely, Jess's software breadth could strengthen Arfan's systems thinking. Both are Bay Area–based, making collaboration natural.
intro_message: Jess Tada, meet Arfan — he's a systems prototyping engineer from Apple with deep expertise in hardware-software integration and embedded systems, and your full-stack software skills could be a great complement if your stealth project has any hardware or IoT dimension.
